24 With which waves can the Doppler effect be observed?
A
all waves including sound and light
B
light waves only
C
sound and light waves only
D
sound waves only

hints: Notice the wording asks about all waves, not just the familiar ambulance siren example for sound.
Recall the cause of the Doppler effect: relative motion between source and observer changes the observed wavelength $\lambda$ and frequency $f$ with $v = f\lambda$.
Check whether that cause depends on the wave type - compare pitch change for sound with redshift for light from distant galaxies.
walkthrough: Identify what the question tests: for which types of wave motion can relative motion of source and observer produce an observed frequency shift.
State the physical rule: the Doppler effect occurs when there is relative motion along the line joining source and observer, compressing waves ahead and stretching them behind.
Apply to sound waves: a moving siren gives higher observed $f$ on approach and lower observed $f$ on recession, a well known sound example.
Apply to light waves: receding galaxies show increased observed $\lambda$ called redshift, and approaching sources show blueshift, so light also shows the effect.

Generalise the cause-and-effect chain: because the effect needs only wave propagation and relative motion, it applies to mechanical waves like water and sound and to electromagnetic waves like light and microwaves.
Therefore it is not limited to sound only, light only, or sound and light only. This is option A.

A.explanation: The Doppler effect is a general wave property where relative motion changes the observed frequency and wavelength for sound, light and all other waves.

B.explanation: Light does show redshift and blueshift, but sound also shows pitch change with a moving source, so it is not light only.

C.explanation: Sound and light both show the effect, but so do water waves, microwaves and other electromagnetic and mechanical waves.

D.explanation: Sound is the familiar example with ambulances, but light from receding galaxies also shows a Doppler shift, so it is not sound only.
